Hi team, [PERSON] here, reporting from the [LOCATION] women's group meeting in [LOCATION]. Today was our monthly table banking day. Twenty-five members attended out of thirty. Together they saved eighteen thousand shillings, and we gave out four small loans to members who are starting businesses, mostly selling vegetables and second-hand clothes. The treasurer, [PERSON], recorded everything in the book. Our next meeting is on the fifteenth. If you need the records, [PERSON]'s number is [PHONE].

Morning everyone, this is [PERSON]. Yesterday we went to [LOCATION] Primary School for the menstrual hygiene session with the girls in class six to eight. Sixty girls attended. We talked about periods, how to use and dispose of pads safely, and why they should not miss school. At the end, every girl received a pack of reusable sanitary pads. The head teacher, Mrs. [PERSON], has asked us to come back and also talk to the mothers. Her phone number is [PHONE] if someone wants to follow up.

anonymized_text: Hello team, it's [PERSON]. I want to share about the community dialogue on gender-based violence we held this afternoon at the chief's camp in [LOCATION]. Thirty-five women attended, plus a few village elders. The police gender desk officer, Corporal [PERSON], explained how to report cases and where survivors can get help. Some women shared their stories, it was very emotional. Three women asked for private follow-up, and we connected them with the counsellor. For anything about this session, you can call me on [PHONE].

Please, whoever is going to [LOCATION] that day, help her with transport. Her number is [PHONE]. I will upload the full report later.

[PERSON], congratulations to [PERSON] on the new baby! We are so happy for you. Ladies, let's plan to visit her this weekend at her home in [LOCATION], after church. I suggest we each contribute two hundred shillings for a small gift, maybe a baby blanket and some unga. Send your contribution to [PERSON] on [LOCATION]-[LOCATION], her number is [PHONE]. And please, don't forget to bring your own chairs, last time we were standing. Okay, have a blessed evening.

Hello team, this is [PERSON] reporting from [LOCATION]. Today we held the kitchen garden training for women farmers. Eighteen women attended. The agriculture officer, Mr. [PERSON], showed them how to make a sack garden and how to make compost from kitchen waste. Each woman received seedlings of sukuma wiki and spinach to plant at home. Next month we will visit their homes to see how the gardens are doing. If you want to join the follow-up visits, call me on [PHONE].

Good evening, this is [PERSON]. I was helping Sister [PERSON] at the screening camp in [LOCATION] today. Just adding to her report: we had twenty-eight women screened for cervical cancer, and three were referred to Nakuru Level Five.
